hypotheses.justification: The conclusion does not mention connectedness of X, and the proof never uses it. It appears only as an unused instance argument threaded through the helper lemmas range_ι_comp_eq_univ, exists_mem_translate, iSup_preimage_inf_eq and le_iSup_preimage_imagePreimage. I read the proof of range_ι_comp_eq_univ, the only place it could matter. That proof uses the following. (1) The finiteness of G, for isClosed_iUnion_of_finite. (2) The closedness of π.base, from IsFinite π via π.isClosedMap. (3) hsurj and horbit. (4) The clopenness of π.base '' W, which gives π.base '' W = univ because it is nonempty. This last step uses connectedness of the closed set π.base '' W's complement structure only through `hclopen.eq_univ hne`, and that comes from the complement-image argument, not from ConnectedSpace X. So no step uses ConnectedSpace X. The theorem therefore stays true and provable after deleting the binder, provided the same instance argument is also dropped from those four helper lemmas, whose proofs need no change.
